purpose: Fine-line isometric objects with causal lighting and optional native Three.js scenes.
install: Download the official skill archive from https://isoglow.dev/ and follow its installation instructions.
limitations: Native HTML/Three.js output; use media or a browser project when the figure has no seek API.

purpose: Native interactive isometric figures and a skill for custom illustrations.
install: npm install @lucasmarkes/hairline; npx skills add lucasmarkes/hairline
limitations: Pointer-driven figures are not automatically seekable video scenes.

purpose: Isometric drawing method and custom object authoring.
Original diagram selection, geometry, layout and motion.
Existing mechanism figures or native authoring of new mechanisms.
install: npm install anatomy-figures; npx skills add wheresryan22/anatomy
limitations: Not a chart library; figure theme and seeking support vary.

purpose: Mathematical animation rendered as reusable native media with Manim Community.
install: Use the official uv installation workflow in a project-local Python environment.
limitations: Distinct from ManimGL; preserve the engine identity in scene source.

purpose: Original 3Blue1Brown engine and manimlib scene API.
install: Follow the upstream installation and project requirements.
limitations: Do not substitute Manim Community scene APIs without migration.

purpose: Experimental Rust implementation and Python portal for manimlib-compatible work.
install: Reference only in this release. Consult upstream current capabilities and license before adoption.
limitations: README mixes current capabilities with a 1.0 target. Python portal currently documents PNG output; video and reproducibility claims need independent verification. License includes an additional rider.

purpose: Preferred native Rust/SVG video composition, scenes, audio and rendering.
install: cargo install cargo-fframes --locked; npx skills add https://fframes.studio
limitations: Native Rust/SVG project; arbitrary browser React does not translate automatically.

purpose: Native browser video when a composition needs DOM, CSS or browser graphics.
install: Follow upstream project initialization and skills instructions.
limitations: Select explicitly for browser compositions; the template owns this renderer.
